activeStrategy.summary: Creates or resolves the target department, resolves bank and expense accounts, picks VAT only when the chosen account is not VAT-locked, posts a direct manual voucher, and uploads the source receipt to that voucher.
activeStrategy.hypothesis: The winning task-22 branch is a direct voucher plus attachment flow, with account and VAT selected deterministically from the booked receipt line instead of using supplier-invoice import paths.
stepOutline: Department branch: POST /department for the normal fresh-account path, or GET /department with exact-name local filtering when the prompt explicitly says the department already exists.
API call 2: GET /ledger/account for account 1920 plus the deterministic expense-account candidate set.
Optional VAT call: GET /ledger/vatType only when the chosen expense account is not VAT-locked.
API call 4 or 5: POST /ledger/voucher with one expense line and one balancing bank line.
Final API call: POST /ledger/voucher/{voucherId}/attachment with the original receipt PDF.
